_comment: THE spot table for the title-screen panoramas. Rendered on Will's PC by tools/panorama/local_render.py
(real GPU, Complementary Reimagined, Distant Horizons far terrain; README.md there), or in CI by
.github/workflows/panoramas.yml (llvmpipe, no far terrain). One entry = one 6-face panorama, made by
OriginDevPanorama in the 'capture' module and shipped as assets/minecraft/textures/gui/title/background/
panorama_0..5.png in every module listed in 'targets' (install.py).
capture: the module that renders it. Older updates render in a newer client whose worlds still generate
seed: the world seed (default 4242424242). at: [x, z] (or [x, y, z]) to start from, from a seed's
sourced coordinates; else locate: the arguments after /locate (biome <id> | structure <id>), offset [dx, dz].
open: search radius (blocks) for the ground spot with the clearest all-round view (no cliff, wall or trunk
near any face), favouring 'biome' (default: the located biome; 'a|b' = any of them). Face 0 then looks
where that biome shows most, unless 'yaw' (0 = south, 90 = west, 180 = north, -90 = east) or
lookAt [x, z] is given. Faces 1-3 turn +90 each, 4 looks up, 5 down.
ground: surface (default) or floor (first air over solid scanning down: Nether, caves); up: feet above it
(0 = standing on the ground, eye at +1.62). vista/maxRise/flatWeight: the older overlook search (CI spots).
time: /time set value (frozen). renderDistance: vanilla chunks (far terrain goes beyond).
mobs: summoned NoAI in view of face 0 at dist blocks, angle degrees off face 0's centre, up blocks above
their ground, turn = extra yaw for a 3/4 view, nbt merged into the summon.
commands: run at the camera's ground point facing face 0 (so ~ and ^ coordinates work).
light: [[dy, level, radius], ...] invisible light layers for cave spots.

shaderpack.name: Complementary Reimagined
shaderpack.license: Complementary License Agreement 1.6 (License.txt in the pack), 1.1: free to use 'for content creation'. Origin never ships or redistributes the pack (2.1: anything else is All Rights Reserved), only its own renders.
shaderpack.optionsWhy: Capture-safe: no vignette (it darkened every face's border = the black seams in the sky), clouds and foliage frozen so the six faces agree where they meet, no lens flare. Quality up for a real GPU.

farTerrain._why: Voxy has no 1.21.1 build and only ingests chunks that were loaded (pregen + import per world); Distant Horizons exists for every capture module and generates the land around the camera itself, so one tool covers all spots.

Caves & Cliffs part 1: goats on snowy mountain slopes

spots.about: The Wild: a mangrove swamp with the warm frogs that spawn there (no allays: they live only at outposts and mansions)
Trails & Tales: a cherry grove with the sheep, pig and rabbit that spawn there (no camel or sniffer: neither spawns in one)
Tricky Trials: armadillos in the savanna and badlands where they spawn (nothing placed)
spots.seedSource: wisehosting.com/minecraft-seeds/badlands-and-savanna-caldera-village (Java 1.20-1.21.11, caldera split between badlands and savanna)

spots.about: The Garden Awakens: standing inside a generated pale garden by day, pale oaks, pale moss and hanging moss all round (creakings come out only at night, so none are shown)
Chase the Skies: a soul sand valley facing a generated dried ghast (where the happy ghast comes from) with the ghasts that spawn there; happy ghasts never spawn naturally, so none are summoned
The Copper Age: a plains village. Copper golems and copper chests never generate (players build them), so nothing is placed or summoned
Mounts of Mayhem: a desert with a husk riding a camel husk and a parched, the desert's new spawns, by a desert temple
26.1: the redesigned baby animals in sunflower plains, where cows, pigs and sheep spawn (nothing placed)

26.2: inside a whole sulfur cave, yellow sulfur and red cinnabar on every side, with the sulfur cubes that spawn there; the harness picks the widest cave lined with the biome's own blocks and lights it
